About

I am a Business Intelligence Analyst who has spent 5 years building the analytics infrastructure that finance teams, executives, and business leaders actually rely on to make decisions, not just reports they open once and forget.

At TripAdvisor, I owned the company's highest-traffic finance reporting platform, defined the KPI framework leadership used for strategic planning, and executed a zero-downtime migration of 20+ executive dashboards to Tableau Cloud without a single reporting outage. At Staples, I built the competitive pricing intelligence system that tracked Amazon, Walmart, and key retailers at SKU level. At Revolutionary Integration Group, I conducted end-to-end market analysis, built financial models, and shaped product strategy for regulated industries including healthcare and defense.

What makes me different is not just the tools I know. It is knowing when a data problem is actually a business problem, and having the communication skills to bridge that gap with stakeholders at every level. I have worked with finance leads, product teams, and C-suite executives, and I speak all three languages fluently.

Currently deepening my edge in Generative AI for data analysis, certified by IBM in GenAI for BI Analysts specifically, and by Microsoft and Google across data analysis and AI essentials. The analysts who will matter most in the next five years are the ones who know how to pair human judgment with AI speed.

// Featured Project · 01

Strategic KPI Framework & Executive Dashboard

The ProblemA new company strategy lacked standardized metrics. Leadership had no single source of truth to evaluate performance. Every team measured success differently, and no one agreed on what "good" looked like.

What I BuiltDefined core KPIs including ARPU and engagement metrics, then built end-to-end SQL + Snowflake ETL pipelines feeding a Tableau dashboard with daily, week-over-week, and month-over-month tracking. Ran cross-functional alignment sessions to get every stakeholder on the same metric definitions.

The ImpactThe dashboard became the primary executive decision-making tool across the organization, standardizing performance measurement and enabling leadership to make faster, more confident strategic calls.

// 02 TripAdvisor

Tableau Cloud & Snowflake Schema Migration

ProblemThe Finance team needed to simultaneously migrate the Snowflake data schema and 20+ Tableau dashboards to Tableau Cloud, including executive reporting used for daily decisions. One wrong move meant a reporting blackout at the leadership level.

Took full ownership of the migration. Audited all dashboards by business criticality, designed a phased strategy to avoid full system cutover, and coordinated parallel migration of Snowflake tables and Tableau dashboards with aligned dependencies. Implemented validation checks before each schema switch and maintained proactive stakeholder communication throughout, ensuring critical executive dashboards stayed live while lower-priority ones migrated in stages.

✓ Zero reporting outages · Executive dashboards maintained throughout · Strengthened stakeholder trust
